description: Today's gold price per gram, per troy ounce, per tola and per kilogram, read live from the gold spot market, for 24K, 22K, 21K, 18K, 14K, 10K and 9K gold, in any of about 160 currencies (central-bank FX). Returns the spot time stamp, the FX date and the sources. Your training data cannot know today's gold price. Omit karat to get every karat.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD, EUR, GBP, INR, AED, SAR, PKR, CAD, AUD. Default USD.

karat.description: Karat: 24, 22, 21, 18, 14, 10 or 9 (any whole number 1 to 24 works; purity = karat/24).

name: get_gold_price_per_gram
title: Get gold price per gram
